title.en: Kinou made Namae mo Yonde Kurenakatta Koushaku-sama ga, Kyuu ni Dekiai shitekuru no desu ga?

altTitles.ja: 昨日まで名前も呼んでくれなかった公爵様が、急に溺愛してくるのですが？@COMIC

altTitles.en: If Another Miracle Happens… I’ll Devote My Life to Making You Happy, No Matter What.
How did the cold duke suddenly turn into an obsessed lover

description.en:
A fantasy romance that begins with death and rebirth, uniting a cold-hearted duke and a gentle, unlucky noblewoman known as the Goddess of Calm.

What baffles Marienne the most is the sudden change in the behavior of her husband, Duke Alexia, infamous for his icy demeanor and harshness.
Once trapped in a cold, lonely castle within a loveless marriage, she suddenly finds herself facing a man who proposes to her all over again—and begins to woo her as if she were his goddess, someone he simply can’t live without.

Each day, she receives lavish bouquets adorned with jewels, hears words of love that sound like they came straight out of a fairy tale,
and with every sincere phrase and awkward emotion, her frozen heart slowly begins to melt.

But… what caused this sudden shift?
Is it just a mask?
Is there a hidden reason behind his complete change of heart?

Her mind is full of doubts, but amid the confusion, one truth keeps echoing from his lips:

“If another miracle happens… I’ll devote my life to making you happy.”

A story of second chances, of a once-frozen heart and a woman who has suffered more than her share…
Can love truly be born from the ashes?
